name: PlenOctree Conversion
definition: A pipeline to convert a trained NeRF-SH model into a sparse octree representation (PlenOctree) for real-time rendering. The octree stores density and SH coefficients at leaves.
summary: PlenOctree Conversion transforms a trained NeRF-SH model into a sparse octree, enabling real-time rendering by replacing online neural queries with direct lookups of precomputed density and spherical harmonic coefficients.
